roles.faqH2: Tile installation FAQ for Woodinville, WA
roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Woodinville, WA?
roles.faqA1: Woodinville tile installation totals $14 to $26 per square foot installed — tile, labor, substrate prep and setting materials all in — and labor alone begins at $11/sq ft. A tub-shower surround typically runs $3,200 to $6,800; a bathroom floor of roughly 45 sq ft runs $900 to $1,600; and a full bathroom covering floor, shower and niche comes in between $6,500 and $14,000. Which tile you pick matters less than its shape: mosaic sheets and large-format both cost noticeably more labor per foot than standard 12×12.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Woodinville?
roles.faqA2: A standard Woodinville alcove shower prices in the $3,200–$6,800 corridor — demolition, a sloped and waterproofed pan, wall membrane, tile, niche and grout inside. Benches, curbless entries, steam or ceiling-height stone lift it from there. One dollar in ten roughly goes to waterproofing: the cheapest defense against a framing repair that runs five figures.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Every shower, no exceptions. The build follows TCNA methods with an ANSI A118.10 bonded membrane: pre-sloped base, membrane carried up the walls, corners, seams and penetrations sealed, then a 24-hour flood test held, photographed and documented before tile is set. People assume grout keeps water out — it doesn't, and neither does tile. The membrane is the only true barrier between your shower and your framing.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: A Woodinville bathroom takes four to six working days, give or take: demolition with dust protection, then substrate and waterproofing with a 24-hour flood test behind it, a day or two setting tile, and a last day of grout, silicone and trim. Grout wants 24 more hours of cure before the first shower. Floors alone finish in one to two days — worth knowing before you plan a party.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Porcelain for the hard-working surfaces — floors, shower floors, anything wet or trafficked. It's the denser material, resists chips, and takes on less than 0.5% water. Ceramic belongs on walls and backsplashes, where it's lighter on the budget and does the job well. That's exactly how we spec Woodinville projects: porcelain underfoot, ceramic or glass where it only has to look good.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes. At $11–$16 per square foot installed — thermostat included — an electric radiant mat is the least expensive luxury in the house, provided you add it while the floor is already open. It installs over an uncoupling membrane, gets a resistance test before setting and another after, and draws from its own dedicated circuit. Barefoot hosting in January makes the argument for you.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: In most cases, yes. Demolition plus haul-away runs from $3.50 per square foot and buys you certainty: a clear view of the subfloor, any rot or movement found early, and door thresholds that still line up when the new floor goes down. A sound, flat, well-bonded floor can sometimes take tile over tile — but it lifts the floor height and papers over exactly what we'd want to see.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Woodinville?
roles.faqA8: A Woodinville kitchen backsplash of the usual 30 sq ft installs for $1,100 to $2,200, outlet cuts, edge trim and counter-matched grout included. Tasting-room-style choices — herringbone, mosaic sheets, a picture-framed panel behind the range, slab-look porcelain to the ceiling — sit at the top of the range because layout and cutting time climb with them.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Very often. With an $8-per-square-foot starting rate, repair and regrout handles stained or crumbling grout, the stray tile cracked by a dropped stockpot, and corners overdue for silicone. Its limit is failed substrate — hollow-sounding tile, loosening in patterns, walls that give — where a patch purchases months at most. Before quoting anything we tell you plainly which side of that line your bathroom stands on.
roles.faqQ10: Which Woodinville neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: Every corner of Woodinville — Hollywood Hill, English Hill, Wellington and West Wellington, Leota, the Wedge, Town Center, the Hollywood District and the Sammamish Valley — plus Cottage Lake, Bear Creek, Maltby, Kingsgate, Norway Hill, North Creek and Clearview next door. Bothell, Kirkland, Redmond and the rest of the Eastside are close behind.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: Tile from OC Flooring carries 2 years of workmanship coverage — double the carpet term, for faults that skip the first week and arrive in the second year. Choose the manufacturer's complete waterproofing assembly and its warranty runs in parallel with ours. Photographs of every membrane and every flood test go on file, so proof of what's behind the tile exists whenever the house sells.
